udp_like_status.outer_semantics: WBD-owned TCP-shaped raw carrier with earliest-complete inner datagram delivery; platform TCP reliability remains above WBD. Game lanes are independent outer associations rather than duplicate ciphertext in one flow.
udp_like_status.fec_status: Release wire path remains off or fixed systematic 20:20 unless an explicit future ADR changes it. Research formula may evaluate other profiles but must not silently change the live wire profile.
udp_like_status.capacity_policy: ADR-0010 release authority remains 40 Mbit/s aggregate inner on <=100 Mbit/s physical weak-link qualification.
udp_like_status.link_speed_policy: Auto and manual link-speed authorities remain distinct; manual must work without an auto sample, and auto capacity estimation must remain separate from loss/burst statistics.
udp_like_status.game_mode: User-selectable 1..4 lanes remain independent outer associations with first-arrival dedupe; logical inner pacing occurs before replication and accounts for actual lane/FEC/carrier expansion.

Windows Wintun device, route lifecycle and real bidirectional admin dataplane are green. The pinned Windows wolfSSL DTLS shim build and usage smoke are green in run 32999869554. Full Windows WBD GUI/runtime composition is not yet qualified.

product_policy.link_setup: Reality-like TLS front remains setup/admission only; sustained payload remains WBD FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK.
product_policy.accounts: One shared username/password may authenticate multiple simultaneous devices; routing/session state is ticket/LiveID/peer keyed, never username keyed.
product_policy.fullcone_nat: OpenWrt UDP is endpoint-independent mapping plus endpoint-independent filtering and has a root-qualified hairpin/NAT-loopback gate. This is platform behavior, not transport semantics.
product_policy.windows_gui: Windows product requires a native GUI. Minimize and window-close hide to the system tray and keep VPN running; tray restores the window; explicit Disconnect stops the tunnel; explicit Exit performs cleanup then terminates. Explorer/taskbar restart must restore the tray icon. GUI must call a runtime controller rather than embed transport logic in the UI thread.
product_policy.settings_testing: Every exposed game/link-speed/FEC/lane/pacing setting must retain executable validation; do not regress previously green game-settings-matrix or game-lane-fullstack coverage.
